tasks.title: Lecture #45
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a music class.
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hip hop is one of the world's most popular musical genres. I want to discuss a characteristic feature of this art form, sampling. Sampling refers to the reuse of a part of an existing song in a new composition.
Hip hop artists might write a song that uses part of a vocal track or a drum beat, or some other sound from an existing song. For example, the singer Beyonce 's 2003hit Crazy in Love uses a melody from a 1970 release by the band The Shy Lights.
Sampling was especially common in the early days of hip hop, before the landmark 1991 US District Court case “Grand Upright Music Limited versus Warner Brothers Records Inc.” The ruling in that case required artists to obtain permission to use samples in their recordings. Before that legal decision, sampling had been a relatively cheap and easy practice. It continued afterward, down to today, but in a more limited way.
Critics often argue that sampling is a less creative approach than traditional music making, but I'd respond that all art, especially music, is referential. In creating a new work, all artists borrow in one manner or another from existing works of art. Hip hop creativity comes in finding unusual sources or putting recognizable material into new contexts. But now I'd like to know what you think. Let's examine the Sonic collage that is Paul's Boutique, the 1989 album from the Beastie Boys, which utilizes A remarkable number of samples.

options.A: Listening to music from different genres
options.C: Combining a range of musical styles in one song
options.D: Using pieces of recorded music in a new song

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 说话者是如何定义“采样”的？ 定位原文: "Sampling refers to the reuse of a part of an existing song in a new composition." 选项分析: A. Listening to music from different genres (听不同流派的音乐) - 错误。这是对“sampling”字面意思的误解，与定义无关。 B. Choosing particular musicians to research (选择特定的音乐家进行研究) - 错误。与创作新歌曲无关。 C. Combining a range of musical styles in one song (在一首歌中结合多种音乐风格) - 错误。虽然采样可能涉及风格融合，但定义的核心是“reuse of a part”（重用片段），而非风格融合。 D. Using pieces of recorded music in a new song (在新歌中使用录音片段) - 正确。这与原文“reuse of a part of an existing song”完全对应。

questions.stem: What event does the speaker say caused a change to a creative process?

options.C: The invention of a new instrument
options.D: The start of a new recording company

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 说话者说是什么事件导致了创作过程的改变？ 定位原文: "The ruling in that case required artists to obtain permission to use samples in their recordings. Before that legal decision, sampling had been a relatively cheap and easy practice." 选项分析: A. A legal case (一个法律案件) - 正确。文中明确提到了“1991 US District Court case”以及“legal decision”改变了采样变得昂贵和受限的现状。 B. A concert (一场音乐会) - 错误。文中未提及。 C. The invention of a new instrument (一种新乐器的发明) - 错误。文中未提及。 D. The start of a new recording company (一家新唱片公司的成立) - 错误。虽然提到了Warner Brothers Records，但重点在于它是被告方，而非公司的成立导致了变化。

questions.stem: What is the speaker's attitude toward sampling?

options.A: She disagrees with the criticism that it lacks creativity.
options.B: She believes that it is a unique practice in the history of music.
options.C: She is disappointed that it is no longer commonly used.
options.D: She has not yet decided how she feels about it.

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 说话者对采样的态度是什么？ 定位原文: "Critics often argue that sampling is a less creative approach than traditional music making, but I'd respond that all art, especially music, is referential." 选项分析: A. She disagrees with the criticism that it lacks creativity. (她不同意关于它缺乏创造力的批评。) - 正确。说话者用“but I'd respond...”反驳了批评者的观点，认为所有艺术都是相互参照的，嘻哈的创造力在于寻找不寻常的来源。 B. She believes that it is a unique practice in the history of music. (她认为这是音乐史上独特的做法。) - 错误。她认为所有艺术都是“referential”（相互参照的），暗示这并非嘻哈独有。 C. She is disappointed that it is no longer commonly used. (她对它不再常用感到失望。) -错误。她说它“continued afterward... but in a more limited way”，并没有表达失望的情绪。 D. She has not yet decided how she feels about it. (她还没决定怎么看待它。) - 错误。她的立场非常明确，支持采样的创造性。

questions.stem: What will the speaker most likely do next?

options.B: Discuss the artwork from an album cover
options.D: Help students do their own sampling

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 说话者接下来最可能会做什么？ 定位原文: "Let's examine the Sonic collage that is Paul's Boutique, the 1989 album from the Beastie Boys, which utilizes A remarkable number of samples." 选项分析: A. Take a survey (做一个调查) - 错误。虽然前面说了“I'd like to know what you think”，但紧接着的具体行动是“examine the Sonic collage”，即分析具体作品。 B. Discuss the artwork from an album cover (讨论专辑封面的艺术) - 错误。文中提到的是“Sonic collage”（声音拼贴），指音乐本身，而非视觉封面。 C. Play a recording (播放一段录音) - 正确。在音乐课上，当老师说“Let's examine...album... utilizes samples”时，最自然的下一步就是播放这张专辑的片段来让学生听其中的采样。 D. Help students do their own sampling (帮助学生做他们自己的采样) - 错误。这是分析现有作品，不是实践课。
